regimeSub: SPX drops 0.8% as 10Y holds 5.17%, growth stalls at 1.5% with inflation sticky at 3.7%.
themes: Warsh's Sept 16 hike to 4.0% still driving 10Y at 5.17% (-1bp DoD) → 2Y falls 6bps to 4.81% but still prices Dec hike odds while Q2 GDP stuck at 1.5% YoY vs 2.1% prior quarter confirms stagflation setup

Brent grinds higher to $99.64 (+1.3% DoD) as Saudi output disruptions linger post-Iran interim deal → WTI at $94.16 keeps energy pass-through alive with Aug CPI at 3.7% and core PCE at 3.3%, both well above Fed's 2% target

BOK rate pressure intensifies with 100bp Fed gap per Korea JoongAng Sept 17 → USDKRW stable at 1357 as HBM chip boom supports won, but BOK hawk Rhee signals potential Oct hike given inflation spillover from semiconductor capex surge

SPX slides 0.8% to 7683 as bond rout fatigue sets in → VIX rises to 16.07 from 14.87 suggesting complacency fading, gold at $4164 (-1.5% DoD) consolidates after stagflation hedge bid, retail sales +1.2% MoM shows consumer still spending through pain

signalNotes.name: US Real Rate
signalNotes.note: 10Y real at ~1.87% (5.17% nominal vs 3.3% core PCE) crushing duration, Warsh's hawkish regime keeps pressure on

signalNotes.note: Curve at +36bps (5.17% vs 4.81%) steepening from +31bps as front-end reprices slower vs back-end fiscal fears

signalNotes.name: HY Credit Spread
signalNotes.note: HY holding steady despite SPX -0.8% drop — credit not confirming equity weakness yet, watch for lag

signalNotes.note: VIX jumps to 16.07 from 14.87 (+8%) as SPX falls — vol repricing but still historically low given macro backdrop

signalNotes.name: Brent Crude
signalNotes.note: Brent at $99.64 approaching triple digits again despite Hormuz reopening — Saudi disruptions keep bid under oil

signalNotes.name: Gold
signalNotes.note: Gold pulls back to $4164 from $4229 (-1.5%) as real rates bite, but stagflation bid keeps floor elevated

signalNotes.name: USD / KRW
signalNotes.note: USDKRW holds 1357 flat WoW as HBM boom supports KRW vs 100bp Fed rate gap pressure — BOK Oct hike in play

signalNotes.name: Semiconductor SOX
signalNotes.note: Chip sector mixed as TSMC capex boost meets SK Hynix-Samsung market cap flip — HBM demand strong but valuations stretched

headline: Warsh's Fed hike regime grinds on as 10Y holds above 5% with Brent near $100, Q2 GDP at 1.5% and CPI at 3.7% confirm entrenched stagflation while SPX finally cracks 0.8% as VIX wakes up to 16.
